answer: Each identity must post a 500-unit bond escrowed against a single device credential, an anchor that cannot be cloned across machines. A sybil attacker replicating identities locks 500 units per copy, forfeits 100 percent on proven fraud, and waits 30 epochs for release. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake while shared slashing and independent jurors leave no hollow profit and no sparrow-sized gain.
